resources/js/components/charts/time-seri: Adds a latest-value legend for snapshot metrics. Summing each day would count the same open finding more than once (#459). Drop the override when the registry supports a latest-value legend.
resources/js/components/grouped-view-tab: A sub-menu trigger that names the open view ("Issues: Findings") shows that view's count and severity instead of the group's sum, which read as a wrong count next to the list (#426). Proposed upstream in app-ui; drop this entry when the registry has it.
resources/js/components/ui/drawer.tsx: Remembers the focused element when the drawer opens and returns focus to it on close, because drawers opened from a plain button (controlled `open`, no DrawerTrigger) otherwise leave focus on <body> (WCAG 2.4.3, #422). To be proposed upstream as a registry change; drop this entry when the registry has it.
resources/js/components/sidebar-entity-l: Adds an optional `leading` node to SidebarEntity, rendered after the status icon in the row and in the icon-only flyout, so project rows show their avatar or logo (#287). To be proposed upstream as a registry change (qiick-io/app-ui#125); drop this entry when the registry has it.
resources/js/components/breadcrumbs.tsx: Adds an optional `leading` node to BreadcrumbItemType, rendered before the title, so the project page header shows the project's avatar or logo next to its name (#287). To be proposed upstream as a registry change; drop this entry when the registry has it.
resources/js/components/stat-card.tsx: Formats the trend delta with toLocaleString() so large changes show grouped digits (+1,234), like the value (#207). Proposed upstream in qiick-io/app-ui#123; drop this entry when the registry has it.
